name: data-format-bridge
title_zh: 临床统计师双击就开的表格转换器
tagline_zh: 不用求人导格式：csv/xlsx/h5ad 一键变 .sav/.dta/.rds/.pzfx。
tagline_en: Stop begging for format help: csv/xlsx/h5ad to .sav/.dta/.rds/.pzfx in one go, with ready R script and Prism wide.
desc_en: Convert analysis tables (csv/tsv/xlsx/parquet/h5ad obs-var/rds/sav/dta) into the formats clinicians and statisticians open directly — SPSS .sav, Stata .dta, R .rds with a ready-to-run .R script, GraphPad Prism .pzfx plus a Prism-ready wide CSV, and tidy Excel workbooks. Never touches the input file.
why_zh: 它把「分析师的表」和「临床医生/统计师能打开的东西」之间的翻译做成了一键流水线。
why_en: It turns the analyst-to-clinician format gap into a one-click pipeline, even generating the R script for you — not just a.
limit_zh: 只转表格类数据：csv/tsv/xlsx/parquet/h5ad 的 obs-var、rds、sav、dta。
limit_en: Only table-like data: csv/tsv/xlsx/parquet, h5ad obs-var, rds, sav, dta. No cleaning, stats, or plots; output ends at Prism-ready files, analysis is.
title_en: Table converter that opens directly in SPSS/Stata/R/Prism
